activity_summary: Kettleby came to the Feathers among the baskets, before the boat, and said my lord is content. The purse was my lord's own, not the Chamber's: four pounds, for hose. Heminges divided it on a barrel-head into eight parts of ten shillings and did not read the names. He put that purse on one leaf and the Queen's three nights on another, expected, not received. An office is still empty. You did not argue. You are looked for again at Twelfth Day. Two borrowed cloaks went back to a yeoman, counted, and he did not speak. Your ten shillings stayed in your purse.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Heard the content, took the ten shillings, and did not argue.

entities.name: Ambrose Kettleby
entities.context: Brought the purse and the Twelfth Day, and went back to my lord.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Divided eight parts without reading names, and kept the two leaves apart.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Tried to put it on one leaf, was refused, and saved the ears for later.

entities.name: George Bryan
entities.context: Saw the two cloaks counted back in daylight.

entities.name: Augustine Phillips
entities.context: Kept Nick off a song for the river.

entities.name: Thomas Pope
entities.context: Took his ten shillings and made no speech.

entities.name: Nick Sorrell
entities.context: In the yard, and did not sing.

entities.name: Henry Carey, 1st Lord Hunsdon
entities.context: Not in the yard. Kettleby brought his word and his purse.

entities.name: Queen Elizabeth
entities.context: Not in the yard. Her three nights stayed expected.

facets.activity: Heard my lord is content and took ten shillings

quotes.speaker: ambrose_kettleby
quotes.text: My lord bids me say (and I soften it) that he is content.

quotes.speaker: ambrose_kettleby
quotes.text: You will be sent for. Whether you will be paid for is a question for another office.

quotes.speaker: john_heminges
quotes.text: Four pounds. Eight parts of ten shillings.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I am not arguing the distinction.
